name: Habalikhati Nature Camp Mess
signature_dish: Package meals with fresh local fish — rice, dal and fish curry
why_it_matters: Gahirmatha — the world's largest olive ridley turtle rookery — is an undeveloped, protected coast with no hotels, markets or standalone restaurants. The only on-site dining is the mess at Habalikhati Nature Camp, a 9-room beachfront eco-camp reached by a 2.5-hour boat ride from Gupti. All meals are catered by the camp and included in the booking package.
insider_tip: Food here is camp catering, not a restaurant — breakfast, lunch and dinner are complimentary but strictly limited to the number of people on your ticket, so book the right headcount. There are no shops or card/UPI facilities; carry plenty of cash and any extra snacks. The fish is straight from the local fishermen's catch.
signature_address: Habalikhati Nature Camp, Gahirmatha coast, near Bhitarkanika National Park, Kendrapara District, Odisha 754248

name: Gupti Nature Camp Dining
area: Gupti, the boat-access point for Gahirmatha
signature_dish: Home-style Odia meals included with the camp stay
why_it_matters: Gupti is the jetty point from which boats set out across the creeks toward Habalikhati and the Gahirmatha turtle coast. Gupti Nature Camp, one of the Bhitarkanika-area eco-camps, provides catered Odia meals to its guests and is a practical food and overnight base for travellers staging a Gahirmatha trip, since the sanctuary coast itself has nothing.
insider_tip: Use Gupti as your food and supply base before heading into the sanctuary — like all the eco-camps here, meals are package-inclusive and arranged in advance, not walk-in. Confirm catering when you book the camp. Beyond the main towns there is no card or UPI, so carry cash for the whole trip.
signature_address: Gupti Nature Camp, Gupti, Rajnagar, Kendrapara District, Odisha 754248
